label: System Flow
review: VISUAL STYLE — this video is a System Flow diagram, and the following are intended, not defects: a near-black green-grey canvas with no texture; line icons in thin cyan boxes; dotted connectors with small arrowheads that draw themselves from one node to the next; small points of light travelling along connectors (packets), sometimes back along the same line; every element except the active one dimmed to about a third of its brightness while a step is explained; a single soft glow on the active node or packet; the whole diagram moving and rescaling as one (the camera fitting what is visible, pushing in on a step, pulling back); hard cuts to a new diagram when the subject changes; a small pill tag and a short headline near the top; outlined white captions in the lower part of the frame. There are no people, characters or photographs in this style, and their absence is correct. Do report: a label or chip that overlaps another label, a node or text cut off at the frame edge, text too small to read on a phone, a diagram so crowded the active step cannot be found, a packet or highlight on a component the narration is not talking about at that moment, a stretch of more than about three seconds where nothing on screen changes, and a connector that runs through a label.

avoid_for: topics with no structure to diagram
signals: the script names components that talk to each other
the subject is a path a request, packet or signal travels
the script walks through the steps of a pipeline
latency, throughput or a bottleneck is the point
the topic is an architecture or a protocol
